entries.title: Ask PG: Is there any chance of getting points displayed again
entries.author: deutronium
entries.current_title: Ask PG: Is there any chance of getting points displayed again
entries.excerpt: I'm just wondering if theres any plan to bring back the points being displayed for comments. As I find it rather disorientating not having them, as it makes it more difficult to know which comments to read. We could always have a CSS style to hide them for people who don't want them. Also I believe sites like Reddit 'fuzz' their points displayed to help prevent gaming the system.
entries.guide_zh: 不显示分数让读评论失去参照，作者再次询问能否恢复评论积分。
